sourceRules: Manager or trail-operator sources establish named public access; they do not automatically locate the wet edge.
Use a published coordinate only for the feature it describes. Park, parking, carry, portage, dock, and water-entry points are separate roles.
Do not replace a point with a nearby water feature or different facility when the named access evidence does not support that substitution.
